assertions.claim: 20 minutes of cool running water within 3 hours of the burn cuts graft probability to about 0.6 of unwashed (OR 0.6, 95% CI 0.4–0.8, Australian cohort of 2495 children).
assertions.cn_span: 受伤 3 小时内用凉的流动水冲够 20 分钟，最后需要植皮的概率大约只有没冲的六成

assertions.claim: Cool, not icy water — ice worsens the damage.
assertions.cn_span: 是凉水不是冰水，冰敷会加重损伤

assertions.claim: Don't force off clothing stuck to the wound; cover with a clean cloth and go to hospital.
assertions.cn_span: 衣服粘在伤口上别硬撕，冲完拿干净布盖住去医院

assertions.claim: No toothpaste, soy sauce, sesame oil or flour — they hinder depth assessment and raise infection risk.
assertions.cn_span: 牙膏、酱油、香油、面粉都不要抹

assertions.claim: Delayed flushing still helps within three hours; 7-study meta-analysis found the same.
assertions.cn_span: 隔了一会儿才想起来，三小时内补冲仍然有用
